metadata.source_note: Current official Title 43 text. Section 43.20.011 imposes the chapter tax on corporations. Section 43.20.012 expressly makes the tax inapplicable to individuals but permits an individual return for the credits in section 43.20.013. Section 43.20.013 provides resident political-contribution and federal dependent-care-linked credits and conditions payment on an appropriation. This intake proves zero individual tax through the pre-credit stage but does not certify a tax-year-2026 appropriation, current claim mechanics, refundable-credit amount, or signed net liability.
metadata.title: Alaska Statutes Title 43, sections 43.20.011 through 43.20.013
